data.name: Antonija
data.long_meaning: Derived from Antonius, which means 'priceless one'. Antonija is a Slavic variation of Antonia, which means 'priceless, invaluable one'. This beautiful name is often given to girls in Eastern Europe and is deeply rooted in Christian tradition. Antonija is associated with grace, beauty, and preciousness.
